_what: The Studio's cover stage (covers_stage.py): after a production's versions are rendered, the Studio makes every version's cover through image production's cover job and hands them to the filer. Frames, concept, direction, make, check, file; what it picked and why is on the board (Covers tab, GET /api/covers/<production>).
_after_render: true: the render step runs straight on into the covers, in the same Next step job, once every version is rendered. false: the covers wait for the next Next step press.
_skip_closed: true: the stage is never offered or run for a production whose card is approved, live or already carries filed covers, or whose card cannot be read; it keeps 'Open Versions'. false: the card is not read.
_hold_unread: true: a check that could not be read (words off faces, faces against the cast, made by the tool, the card's checks) holds the version with its reason; a brief that names no cast, or a machine with no face reader, holds before anything is sent. false: only a failed check holds.
_concept_required: true: every swipe, the ad's own too, must be one of the avatar's own Explore covers in the cover index with a rated move, or the version is held. false: any named swipe, and unrated covers last.
_pick_set: true: when the brief names no set, the stage takes the filed 3D set the production's own take records, start frames, generated shots or a filed set's record name, the first with a kept print; none filed holds before anything is sent. false: only brief.json covers.set.
_filed_brief: true: when brief.json has no brief_key, the card is looked up by the number the brand's brief list filed the production under (the Studio's filed-brief lookup), so a production filed straight from a card keeps 'Open Versions'. false: brief.json brief_key or brief only.
_face_unread: true: a face check that stopped, gave no record, or whose judge did not answer (UNCHECKED, or an empty or unknown verdict: anything but SAME, GROUP or DIFFERENT) is 'not read': the version is held with the reason and never made again. false: it counts as a miss and is made again.
_whole_hand_off: true: to-file.json and filer_kwargs hand the covers over only when every version is ready (else every thumb is ''); a card counts as covered only when every video on it has a cover, so a card with some covers does not stop the rest being made. false: each ready version is handed over on its own, and any cover on the card closes the stage.
_whole_sentences: true: a headline line ends at . ? ! never at an abbreviation (Mr., Dr., e.g.; No., Vol., Fig. before a number), an initial or an ellipsis inside it; a clause cut is at least 3 words, and a one-word line or a line that opens a quote it does not close is held. false: every . ? ! ends a line and any first clause or one-word line is taken.
_opener_seconds: The opener is this many seconds from the start of each version; one frame a second is read across it.
_headline_words: A headline taken from the opener's words is its line whole, or cut at its first clause, within this many words; a line with no whole clause that fits is held until the brief names one (brief.json covers.<version>.headline).
_remakes: How many times a cover whose faces fail against the cast sheets, or that is the same picture as a sibling, is made again (next-strongest frame, next swipe) before it is held.
_rollback: "on": false turns the stage off: no Covers step after render, the Covers tab says it is off, and covers are made and filed by hand as before. "after_render": false keeps the stage but makes it wait for its own Next step press. One part: set it false (skip_closed, hold_unread, concept_required, pick_set, filed_brief, face_unread, whole_hand_off, whole_sentences). One machine only: VIDEO_STUDIO_COVERS_OFF=1 (all), or a comma list of after_render and the parts. Row COVER-STAGE in team/rollbacks.md.
